lines.4: 「Still, the Tsushima Family? I suppose that was a bit of a blind spot.」
lines.5: What were these two talking about?
lines.6: They were elegantly enjoying afternoon tea.
lines.7: Even that looked picturesque when they did it.
lines.8: 「Princess, this concerns the matter we discussed at lunch.」
lines.9: 「I recommend these four as members of the executive committee.」
lines.15: 「It wasn't casual. If anything, it makes perfect sense.」
lines.16: 「Ah, Tsushima and his friends. That's an option I hadn't considered, you know?」
lines.17: 「Good for you. I am somewhat surprised, but you have passed.」
lines.19: 「I expected the Princess might refuse, so I brought you along first. This is unexpected.」
lines.20: 「As you heard, I recommended you for membership in the student council executive committee.」
